message.content:
Repo: C:\Users\Micro\3D Objects\DEV\deliveryhub_white_label (React 18 + Vite + Redux Toolkit + React Router v6 + TailwindCSS SPA, multi-tenant delivery white-label app with admin/cozinha/motoboy/cliente areas).

I need to understand the current top navigation bar / header component structure so we can plan a new "favorite screens" feature: user selects a page/route as favorite, and a button/shortcut for it then appears in the top bar (desktop only).

Please find and report (with file paths and line numbers):
1. The main layout component(s) that render a top bar / header (used across admin or dashboard areas) — where is it defined, what does it currently render (logo, nav links, user menu, etc)?
2. How routes/pages are structured — is there a central route config (e.g. src/Routes.jsx or similar) listing page names/paths that could be used to populate a "mark as favorite" list?
3. Is there any existing sidebar/menu component listing navigable pages, and does it already have icons/labels per page we could reuse for a favorites picker?
4. Any existing use of localStorage, Zustand, or Redux slices for persisting user UI preferences (search for existing patterns like "zustand", "persist", "localStorage" usage) — this matters because favorites need to persist per-user.
5. Is there any responsive/breakpoint utility already used to distinguish "desktop only" (e.g. Tailwind classes like `hidden md:flex`, or a useMediaQuery hook)?

Report concisely with file:line references. Do not propose implementation — just report what exists so I can plan on top of it.

Now I have a complete picture. Here's the report. ## 1. Top bar / header components There is **no single shared layout/header component** used across all admin+dashboard pages. Instead, each page area re-implements its own `
` inline plus imports the same two nav-menu components: - **Restaurante area** (`/restaurante/*`): every page (`src/pages/restaurante-dashboard/index.jsx:346-361`, and the same pattern repeated in `restaurante-produtos/index.jsx:256`, and ~12 other `restaurante-*` pages) renders its own: ```

{empresa?.name}

Painel Operacional

{/* desktop: opens sidebar */} {/* mobile: opens dropdown */}
``` It then renders two shared nav components: - `src/components/restaurante/RestauranteSidebar.jsx` — desktop-only (`hidden md:block` wrapper, line 16) slide-in drawer, receives a `links` array (`{label, path}`) and renders a list of buttons, highlighting `activePath`. Also shows a "Loja" link and "Sair" (logout). - `src/components/restaurante/MobileMenu.jsx` — mobile-only (`md:hidden`, line 9) dropdown, same `links` prop shape. The `links` array itself is defined **per-page**, e.g. `LINKS` const at `src/pages/restaurante-dashboard/index.jsx:26-42` (Dashboard, Relatórios, Delivery, Cozinha, Produtos, Pedidos, Entregas, Motoboys, Clientes, Financeiro, Caixa, Designer, Cardápio Digital, Config, Sessão), conditionally extended with `COPA_LINK` (line 44-47) and `SALAO_LINKS` (line 49-53) based on `useTipoRestaurante()`. This LINKS array is duplicated (not imported from a shared source) in the other `restaurante-*` pages that import `RestauranteSidebar`/`MobileMenu`. - **Admin area** (`/admin/*`): `src/pages/admin-empresas/index.jsx` defines a local `AdminNav` component (lines 9-42) — a flat inline `
` with a hardcoded `links` array (Dashboard, Empresas, Categorias, Tipos, Tags, Comissões, Configurações) plus a "Sair" button — no icons, text-only. Rendered inside its own `
` at line 214-220. This `AdminNav`/header pattern is local to `admin-empresas/index.jsx` (other admin pages like `admin-tags`, `admin-categorias`, `admin-comissoes` likely repeat similar local nav — not verified individually, but same file-per-page structure applies). - **Customer-facing header**: `src/components/ui/BrandedHeader.jsx` — a genuinely shared, reusable header (logo, restaurant name, desktop search bar `hidden md:flex` at line 71, cart badge, user menu dropdown with login/logout). Used for the customer storefront, not admin/restaurante/motoboy areas. - **Motoboy/garçom/cozinha portals**: not checked in detail, but they don't route through `BrandedHeader`, `RestauranteSidebar`, or `AdminNav` (separate token-based portals per `src/Routes.jsx:118-124`). **Takeaway for planning:** there is no single injection point for a "favorites" button in the top bar today — you'd need to touch the per-page `
` blocks in `restaurante-*` pages (or refactor them into one shared layout first) and separately the `AdminNav`/header in admin pages. ## 2. Central route config `src/Routes.jsx` (137 lines) is the single route table — a flat list of `` entries wrapped in `BrowserRouter` (`src/Routes.jsx:56-136`). It only has `path` + `element`; **no route metadata (no page titles/labels/icons attached here)** — labels currently only exist separately in each page's local `LINKS`/`links` array (see #1) and in the sidebar components. So Routes.jsx alone isn't enough to populate a favorites picker with friendly labels — you'd need to combine it with the label lists from #1 and #3, or build a new central manifest. ## 3. Sidebar/menu components with icons/labels - `src/components/restaurante/RestauranteSidebar.jsx` (72 lines) — labels only (`l.label`, `l.path`), **no icons** per item, just a `Menu` icon in the drawer header (`Icon name="Menu"`, line 30... actually `X` icon for close) and `ExternalLink`/generic icons for the "Loja"/"Sair" buttons. Not decorated per-link. - `src/components/restaurante/MobileMenu.jsx` (38 lines) — same, label-only, no icons. - `src/pages/admin-empresas/index.jsx` `AdminNav` (lines 9-42) — label-only, no icons. - `src/components/AppIcon.jsx` exists as the shared icon component (``, used throughout, e.g. `Menu`, `X`, `ExternalLink`, `Search`, `ShoppingCart`, `User`, etc.) — this is the icon system you'd reuse to add icons to a favorites picker, but currently the nav-link arrays themselves carry no `icon` field, so you'd need to add one. **Conclusion:** no existing per-page icon mapping to reuse directly; only a shared `Icon` component and plain `{label, path}` link arrays scattered across each page file. ## 4. localStorage / Zustand / Redux persistence patterns - **Zustand and @reduxjs/toolkit/redux are listed in `package.json`** (`"zustand": "^5.0.14"`, `"@reduxjs/toolkit": "^2.6.1"`, `"redux": "^5.0.1"`) but are **unused** — no `useSelector`, `useDispatch`, ``, `configureStore`, `createSlice`, or `from 'zustand'` imports found anywhere in `src`. These are dead/scaffold dependencies (likely leftover from project generator), not an active pattern. - **Actual state pattern is React Context** (`src/contexts/AuthContext.jsx`, `src/contexts/LocalModeContext.jsx`) for cross-cutting app state, plus plain **localStorage helper modules** for persistence, e.g.: - `src/utils/multiCart.js:1-79` — module-level `const KEY = 'mcp_multi_cart'`, exports `cartGet()/cartAdd()/cartRemoveOne()/...` that do `JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) ?? '[]')` / `localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(...))`. - `src/utils/printComanda.js:62-63` — `getPrinterName()/setPrinterName()` around a single string key `kitchen_printer_name`. - `src/services/cozinhaPortalService.js:6-7`, `src/services/motoboyAuthService.js:7-8`, `src/services/garcomService.js:6-7` — same get/set token pattern per portal. - `src/pages/restaurant-registration-setup/index.jsx:62-89` — saves wizard form state (`restaurantSetupData`, `restaurantSetupStep`, `restaurantSetupCompleted`) to localStorage, restored on mount. None of these keys are namespaced per-user (no user id in the key) — they're just global browser-scoped keys. If favorites need to be per-user, you'd need to add the current user id (available via `useAuth()` from `AuthContext`, e.g. `user?.id` per `AuthContext.jsx:15`) into the storage key yourself, following the same "plain get/set helper module" convention rather than introducing Zustand/Redux (which aren't wired up anywhere). ## 5. Desktop-only / responsive utilities No custom `useMediaQuery`/breakpoint hook exists anywhere (`matchMedia`, `useMediaQuery`, `useBreakpoint`, `innerWidth` — no matches in `src`). The **entire codebase relies on Tailwind responsive classes**, consistently using the `md:` breakpoint as the mobile/desktop split, e.g.: - `RestauranteSidebar.jsx:16` — `className="hidden md:block"` (desktop-only wrapper). - `MobileMenu.jsx:9` — `className="md:hidden ..."` (mobile-only). - `restaurante-dashboard/index.jsx:352-359` — desktop hamburger button `className="hidden md:flex ..."` vs mobile hamburger `className="md:hidden ..."`. - `BrandedHeader.jsx:71` (`hidden md:flex` for desktop search), `:54` (`md:hidden` for mobile menu button), `:63` (`hidden sm:block`). So "desktop only" for a new favorites bar/button would naturally follow this existing `hidden md:flex` / `md:hidden` Tailwind pattern (`md` = 768px breakpoint per default Tailwind config) rather than a JS media-query hook — that's the codebase's established convention.
